focus: Maintainability: description keywords and test fixtures

findingDetails.title: sk-create-skill test fixture uses old md-generator workflow and resources
findingDetails.claim: The HOLDOUT_LEAK fixture hardcodes "expected_workflow_mode: md-generator", "expected_resources: design-md-generator/references/design-md-format.md", and "evidence_compiled_route: sk-design/md-generator". These are pre-rename identifiers.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update the negative fixture to use sk-design-md-generator and sk-design/sk-design-md-generator if the intent is still to test route leakage, or explicitly label the fixture as historical freeze data.

findingDetails.title: sk-prompt hub description uses bare pre-rename keywords
findingDetails.claim: The keywords array includes "prompt-improve" and "prompt-models" without the sk- prefix. These are not the canonical workflowMode names and can pollute advisor search results.
findingDetails.recommendation: Replace with "sk-prompt-improve" and "sk-prompt-models", or add a clearly-labeled "legacyAliases" field.

findingDetails.title: sk-doc hub description uses bare pre-rename phrases in keywords
findingDetails.claim: The keywords array includes "create diff report" and "document before after review" without the sk- prefix. These match the pre-rename workflow names.
findingDetails.recommendation: Align keywords with the new sk-create-diff name or move legacy phrases to a separate alias list.
